Players Committee card image of [[Jakku: Niima Outpost Shipyard (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Your starfighters take off and land here for free.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
